notes.message: 86 more trials mention the drug or condition only in descriptions, often as one of several permitted options. They are listed under mentions but not counted. Set retrieval.name_matching to mentioned to count them.
Asthma also includes trials whose MeSH condition is "Status Asthmaticus", which sit under it in the MeSH tree.
90 trials were left out because they have no usable enrollment.
